title: Ordinary frequency, period and phase definitions
description: Typed definitions for ordinary frequency; phase requires elapsed physical time and a phase origin.
assumptions: f is a declared ordinary frequency, not an angular frequency.
f is finite and positive; physical time is in seconds and phase in radians.
Phase is unwrapped with an explicit time origin.
mechanism: Definition of period, angular frequency and phase for a constant-frequency oscillator.
primary_sources: SI Brochure, ninth edition: hertz and radian
falsification_conditions: T*f differs from one or inverse phase fails in the declared floating-point domain.
